carla (sales): Orca POC failing JSON schema validation when using function calls + json_mode. They reported lots of small parse errors during bulk sync.
orca-team-jim (customer): example raw output from req oc_3001: ```{\"rows\": [{\"id\": \"r100\", \"ok\": true}], \"meta\": {\"src\": \"sftp\"}}\\nFYI: two rows had warnings```
diego (solutions): please confirm request id, streaming mode, and if you saw 429s.
orca-team-jim (customer): req=oc_3001, stream=true, sdk=1.8. logs show a couple 429s: ```2025-09-12T10:11:22Z WARN req oc_3001 429 qps=38 limit=35
2025-09-12T10:11:23Z INFO partial oc_3001 \"{\\\"rows\\\": [...]} extra note\"```
yara (eng-runtime): streaming + json_mode + rate limits causes trailing human text. Immediate fixes: - set header `X-Redwood-JSON-Mode: strict` - enable `truncate_trailing_text=true` - or set `atomic_response=true` to buffer until full JSON. Also consider a one-time QPS bump for the POC.
lee (security): Orca requires 12mo retention and encrypted logs. Can Dedicated bump support body redaction?
yara (eng-runtime): yes, Dedicated can be configured with redaction and custom retention in contract; hosted default is 30d. For quick wins try strict header + truncate; if 429s persist we can request a temporary uplift.
carla (sales): I'll loop in sales-ops/legal. Orca, can you try strict+truncate and send a new failing sample if it still occurs?
orca-team-jim (customer): switching now, will run 1k-record test and report back in 20m. thanks.
infra-bot: Ticket created: POC-907 for temporary QPS review.
